meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: A fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback that enables AI agents to navigate, click, type, and snapshot pages via structured commands.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用结构化命令自动操控浏览器页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要让AI自动操作浏览器完成点击、输入和截图。
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser pages with structured commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to navigate, click, type, and snapshot web pages.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、录制视频等，就像有一个虚拟浏览器助手。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 访问某个网站、提取页面信息、自动填写表单或测试网页时触发。

say.text: 打开百度首页，截图保存。
say.note: Claude 会打开百度并截图。

say.text: 帮我登录邮箱，填写用户名和密码。
say.note: Claude 会导航到登录页并填写表单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically open web pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, record videos, etc., acting like a virtual browser assistant.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to visit a website, extract page information, auto-fill forms, or test web pages.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open Baidu and screenshot.

say_en.text: Help me log into my email, fill in username and password.
say_en.note: Claude will navigate to login page and fill the form.
